effects.label: Taunt
effects.description: The recipient is forced to attack whoever cast the Taunt debuff on them.The recipient can move freely, but can only use their Combo Attacks.

bio: The Undercity's a messed up town – and that's just how Bryneth likes it. While the Highguard are constrained by pesky things called laws, Bryneth's more a 'frontier justice' kinda gal. Enough criminals have had their bell rung by Bryneth that if they see a ram-shaped shadow flying at their head, they know they're waking up in the slammer.
